title: How a Whiteboard animation works
description: Click any box to pause and explore its code. Play resumes; Restart loads the latest saved animation. Shared Whiteboard controls stay consistent across every animation.
html:
<svg viewBox="0 0 900 360" aria-label="Animation architecture"><defs><marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10z" fill="var(--muted)"/></marker></defs>
<g class="routes"><path id="route0" d="M355 90H545"/><path id="route1" d="M690 130V230"/><path id="route2" d="M545 270H355"/><path id="route3" d="M210 230V130"/></g>
<g class="captions"><text x="450" y="70">save</text><text x="710" y="185">Play</text><text x="450" y="255">code selection</text><text x="188" y="185" text-anchor="end">Restart</text></g>
<g class="node" data-animation-key="Agent source"><rect x="65" y="50" width="290" height="80" rx="12"/><text x="210" y="82" class="title">Agent source</text><text x="210" y="108">HTML · CSS · JavaScript</text></g>
<g class="node" data-animation-key="Saved block"><rect x="545" y="50" width="290" height="80" rx="12"/><text x="690" y="82" class="title">Saved block</text><text x="690" y="108">versioned with this board</text></g>
<g class="node sandbox" data-animation-key="Webview sandbox"><rect x="545" y="230" width="290" height="80" rx="12"/><text x="690" y="262" class="title">Webview sandbox</text><text x="690" y="288">opaque origin · browser policy</text></g>
<g class="node" data-animation-key="Whiteboard controls"><rect x="65" y="230" width="290" height="80" rx="12"/><text x="210" y="262" class="title">Whiteboard controls</text><text x="210" y="288">Play · Pause · Restart</text></g>
<circle id="packet" r="7" fill="var(--accent)"/><text id="status" x="450" y="345" text-anchor="middle"></text></svg>
css: #stage {height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:8px;} svg {width:100%;max-height:100%;font-family:var(--font);} text {fill:var(--foreground);font-size:14px;text-anchor:middle;} .title {font-size:18px;font-weight:600;} .node rect {fill:var(--background);stroke:var(--border);stroke-width:1.5;} .node:hover rect,[data-animation-selected] rect {stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.5;} .sandbox rect {stroke-dasharray:5 4;} .routes path {fill:none;stroke:var(--muted);stroke-width:1.5;marker-end:url(#arrow);} .captions text,#status {fill:var(--muted);font-size:12px;} [data-animation-selected] {outline:none;}
